questions.question: In a letter to the Galatians, Paul said Christ had set believers free. What did Paul tell them to do?

answers.text: Work hard to earn their freedom

questions.question: What did Paul tell the Galatians about people who try to be made right with God by keeping the law?

answers.text: They have been cut off from Christ
They have drawn closer to Christ

questions.question: Paul told the Galatians that circumcision means nothing in Christ Jesus. What did he say does matter?

answers.text: Coming from the right family line
